model.title: A resolution to honor the Americans killed by Hamas terrorists and their affiliates on and after October 7, 2023, to reaffirm the commitment of the United States to seek legal justice on behalf of their families, and for other purposes.

summary.text: The resolution would honor Americans killed by Hamas terrorists and their affiliates, reaffirm the U.S. commitment to pursuing legal justice for the victims and their families, and express solidarity with those affected by these attacks.
